integrity: Finite enumerations are checks, not an exhaustive proof of the all-dimensions formula. Published literature is credited for component counts. Bibliographic priority remains subject to expert historical review.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic two; standard nonalternating dot product; matrices are simultaneously symmetric, zero-diagonal and square-zero; counts individual matrices and not similarity classes. Classical nilpotent-skew-symmetric literature may contain an equivalent form of this special-case count.
title: Square-zero alternating matrices in characteristic two: isotropic-image stratification and exact rank counts
